# Music Practice image requests

<!-- Generated by musicpractice/design/source/build_requests.py. Edit the data there and rerun. -->

Generate each image from its prompt and drop the files in `musicpractice/intake/`.
Until a file is delivered the app draws a stand-in, so nothing here blocks use.
Images belong to a theme (Settings → Theme); each theme has its own set.

**House styles** (already included in every prompt):

- Classic: Clean, warm practice-room illustration: polished walnut wood, brushed brass, cream and ivory, soft studio lighting with a gentle highlight from the upper left, crisp simple shapes with subtle painterly shading, like a premium modern app illustration. Friendly and calm. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one.
- Art Deco: Art Deco illustration in the manner of a 1920s–30s poster and a Chrysler Building interior: black lacquer and polished onyx, gleaming gold leaf and champagne brass, accents of deep jade green and ivory, crisp geometric forms, stepped (ziggurat) silhouettes, sunburst rays, fan motifs, chevrons and fine parallel gold pinstripes, strict symmetry, flat lacquered surfaces with sharp metallic highlights. Elegant, glamorous, simple. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one.
- Vintage 60s: Mid-century 1960s illustration like a vintage record sleeve or a space-age kitchen advert: warm cream, mustard yellow, burnt orange, teal and avocado green, simple rounded shapes, boomerang and starburst (atomic) motifs, flat colour with a soft screen-print grain and slightly offset printing. Cheerful, optimistic, simple. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one.
- 18th Century: 18th-century illustration in the manner of a Rococo engraving and a gilded harpsichord: warm ivory and parchment, carved walnut and fruitwood, burnished gilt, deep burgundy and a little powder blue, scrolling acanthus leaves, shell (rocaille) ornaments and fine engraved hatching. Elegant and refined. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one.
- Robot Future: Sleek science-fiction illustration of a far-future starship console: deep space navy and graphite, glowing cyan and magenta light lines, brushed titanium, glass panels, crisp chamfered geometric forms and fine HUD-style tick marks, a soft neon glow. Clean, futuristic, simple. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one.
- French Nouveau: French Art Nouveau illustration in the manner of Alphonse Mucha and a Paris Métro entrance: soft sage and olive green, cream, muted gold, dusty rose and plum, flowing whiplash curves, lilies, irises and vines, elegant outlined forms with flat, gently graded colour. Graceful and organic. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one.
- Candy: Bright anime and manga illustration: clean bold outlines, flat cel shading with one soft highlight, candy pink, sky blue, lilac and sunny yellow on white, sparkles and little star glints, cute and energetic. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one.
- Steam Punk: Steampunk illustration of Victorian brass machinery: polished brass, copper and dark leather, riveted plates, exposed cogs and gears, small pressure gauges and pipes, warm gaslight glow on dark mahogany. Intricate but readable. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one.

**Anchors:** the metronome body and pendulum are separate layers. Each image records its
canvas size and the point the app pins it by (the body's pivot, the pendulum's hub), so
each theme's art can put them where it likes. The Drone bow records where its hair runs
(frog and tip), which the volume marker follows. Ask for the requested points, then record
the measured ones for the delivered file in `build_requests.py`.

## Metronome animation

### `metronome-body` · Classic · delivered

- File: `musicpractice/app/assets/ui/metronome-body.webp`
- Size: 800×1200, transparent PNG (shipped as WebP)
- Anchors (measured): pivot (400, 985) in a 800×1200 canvas
- Note: The app rotates the separate pendulum image over this one, pivoting on the brass screw at (400, 1000) in an 800×1200 canvas. Exact symmetry and the pivot position matter more than detail; small offsets can be corrected in asset-list data.

```text
A classic pyramid-shaped mechanical metronome in polished walnut, seen exactly straight on from the front, perfectly symmetrical, standing upright and filling the canvas top to bottom with a small margin. The front face is a tall recessed cream panel with a vertical scale of evenly spaced fine tick marks (no numbers). There is NO pendulum, rod or weight anywhere: the face panel is empty apart from the tick marks. Near the bottom of the face, centred left-to-right, a small round brass pivot screw sits exactly at 50% of the width and 83% of the height. A slightly wider walnut base at the bottom. Clean, warm practice-room illustration: polished walnut wood, brushed brass, cream and ivory, soft studio lighting with a gentle highlight from the upper left, crisp simple shapes with subtle painterly shading, like a premium modern app illustration. Friendly and calm. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one. Fully transparent background.
```

Clean, warm practice-room illustration: polished walnut wood, brushed brass, cream and ivory, soft studio lighting with a gentle highlight from the upper left, crisp simple shapes with subtle painterly shading, like a premium modern app illustration. Create the normal Music Practice app icon for iOS and Android, based on the reference illustration. A single conventional mechanical metronome: simple polished walnut tapering pyramid case, ivory tick-mark face, slender brass pendulum tilted slightly right, small brass sliding weight, conventional wooden base. Faithfully keep this ordinary metronome design; no Art Deco steps, jade panels, sunbursts, neon, microphone, record jewel or other objects. ```
